name: Harry's Ridge
region: Mount St. Helens National Volcanic Monument, Washington
why: Along the blast zone of 1980 to a ridge above Spirit Lake, still covered with logs, looking straight into the open crater of Mount St. Helens.
book: Road closed: Highway 504 has been shut below Johnston Ridge since the 2023 landslide; the bridge is being rebuilt and the observatory is expected to reopen in 2027. Check WSDOT before you go. Recreation pass at Johnston Ridge.
dangers: Fully exposed to sun and wind.
Stay on the trail: the blast zone is a restricted research area.

points.name: Johnston Ridge Observatory
points.note: Named after the volcanologist killed here on 18 May 1980.

points.name: Harry's Ridge
points.note: A ridge above Spirit Lake facing the crater, named after Harry R. Truman, the lodge owner who refused to leave.
